parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the exact seven printed fields, argv[1] behavior, std-only Rust 2021 requirement, Cargo layout, package-root test7.rs, black-box constraint, and need for byte-for-byte parity.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It used one AgentSwarm call with six focused probing children and retained implementation, integration, build, verification, and final delivery in the parent.
parallel.implementation: After receiving the child reports, the parent wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/url_parser.rs, and test7.rs implementing fragment, query, scheme, authority/path, userinfo, port normalization, and validity rules.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent integrated the inferred behavior into a single Cargo project, built release artifacts, copied target/release/test7 to /output/test7, and the artifact validator found the expected files.
parallel.verification: The parent ran release build and tests, confirmed six unit tests, compared 224 targeted cases against the reference, and ran 3000 randomized fuzz inputs with zero mismatches before official 40/40 evaluation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished child work, missing artifact, unconsumed result, or evaluator-visible defect remained at closure; the only minor verification note was a failed python3 long-string helper inside a targeted diff script, followed by bash fuzz coverage that passed.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same prompt obligations: exact seven-line output, missing argument exit 1, std-only Rust 2021, Cargo project, package-root test7.rs, and black-box inference from the binary.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main agent owned probing, implementation, build, debugging, verification, and delivery, without subagents or delegation.
serial.implementation: It wrote Cargo.toml, test7.rs, src/url_parser.rs, and src/url_parser/port.rs, then patched module path resolution and later patched first-@ userinfo handling after a differential mismatch.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final serial artifact contained the expected Cargo project and executable at /output/test7 and target/release/test7, with all writes and edits performed by the main agent.
serial.verification: It built with rustc and Cargo, ran a broad differential suite that first found one mismatch, fixed it, reran to 0 mismatches out of 891, and verified UTF-8 and the Cargo binary before official 40/40 evaluation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run had transient build and behavior defects, but they were corrected before closure; no official-evaluator defect remained.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split the reverse-engineering phase across six child agents covering scheme, authority/port, path, query/fragment, validity, and miscellaneous edge cases, while the parent owned implementation and final delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, correction, build, and delivery in the main agent without subagents or delegation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs stated the binary location, forbidden library-source access, seven output fields, and focused scope, and the parent received a combined AgentSwarm result before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained all observations in the main context, using its own probes to refine details such as userinfo splitting and port normalization.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel relied on child-to-parent handoff summaries that were accepted as consistent, while serial carried the context locally. There is no observed lost, stale, conflicting, or unusably bulky handoff.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/url_parser.rs, and test7.rs after consuming the reports, implementing parsing order, authority rebuild, port handling, validity, and raw argument output behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All six child investigations completed and returned through the AgentSwarm aggregate, and the parent explicitly used the convergence before writing code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; results were local shell outputs and edits inside the main trajectory, including mismatch discovery and subsequent fix.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel built in release mode, confirmed unit tests, ran 224 targeted differential cases, then fuzzed 3000 generated inputs with zero failures before finalizing; official evaluation passed 40 of 40.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built with rustc and Cargo, used a differential suite that exposed one mismatch, fixed it, then passed 891 cases and UTF-8/Cargo-bin checks; official evaluation passed 40 of 40.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both verified against the reference binary before closure. Serial's verification found and repaired one mismatch; parallel's verification did not report mismatches after implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used more requests, tokens, and wall time than serial, but completed before timeout and closed with artifact_ok and a successful official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used fewer requests and no subagents, also completed before timeout, and closed only after rebuilding and passing its differential suite.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent extra budget on six concurrent investigations without causing deadline pressure or unfinished work; serial was leaner but still required one fix loop.

outcome_analysis.explanation: This pair is not discordant under the current completed cell/status.json evaluations: both parallel and serial passed 40 of 40 official testcases. The solutions differed mainly in process. Parallel front-loaded behavior discovery through six child probes, consumed their aggregate result, then implemented and verified successfully. Serial performed the same style of black-box inference in one main trajectory, hit one authority/userinfo mismatch in differential testing, fixed it, and then also verified successfully. The parallel coordination did not produce a realized adverse consequence that explains an outcome difference, because there is no outcome difference.
parallel_contributors: Six scoped child probes produced convergent parser observations before implementation.
The parent integrated those observations and verified with unit, targeted differential, and fuzz checks.
serial_contributors: Single-agent probing preserved local context and enabled iterative correction.
Differential testing exposed and fixed the first-@ userinfo authority mismatch before delivery.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial initially had a Rust module-path build error and one behavior mismatch for http://@:80/, both fixed before final evaluation.
Parallel had no recorded post-implementation differential mismatch, though one targeted script noted python3 was unavailable for two long-string generated cases before a bash fuzz test passed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process contrast only, with no retained adverse parallel coordination pattern

candidates.reason: Parallel child work was investigative, and the parent explicitly owned implementation by writing the Cargo project and parser after the AgentSwarm result.
There were no independently implemented components requiring cross-agent reconciliation; parent-owned code assembly handled integration.
The parent wrote the package-root test7.rs, Cargo.toml, library files, built the release binary, and copied /output/test7 before closure.
The parent owned the end-to-end transition from probe synthesis through implementation, build, differential testing, fuzzing, and delivery.
The black-box probing phase informed implementation but did not block productive work long enough to cause unfinished implementation or shortened verification.
Investigation preceded implementation, but the six probes ran concurrently and returned usable findings; no deadline-constrained, incomplete, or under-verified closure followed.
No indispensable implementation or verification path was starved; the parent completed implementation and extensive checks after the child reports.
The six-child fan-out consumed more resources than serial but did not exhaust the run budget, timeout, or displace required work.
Each child scope was bounded to a parser aspect and all completed with reports; no single overbroad child left indispensable work unfinished.
Child prompts carried the known binary path, black-box restriction, seven output fields, missing-arg behavior, and specific scope; no omitted known requirement made child work unusable.
Children were not separately implementing interoperating components; they produced probe reports for parent synthesis, so no missing component interface contract caused incompatibility.
No known finding disappeared during transfer; the parent summarized the six reports as convergent and implemented the derived rules.
The aggregate child result was large, but the parent reduced it into a working implementation and verification plan with no unconsumed dependent action.
The children only probed a stable reference binary, and no later workspace state superseded their findings before parent use.
The parent observed convergence across the six reports rather than incompatible unadjudicated handoffs, and the final behavior passed differential and official tests.
The parent did not accept completion on file existence alone; it built, confirmed tests, ran targeted differential checks, fuzzed, and only then delivered.
No replacement or retry child repeated prior work without inherited findings; the parallel run had one completed swarm and then parent implementation.

Children did not produce implementation artifacts to join, and their completed reports were consumed before the parent wrote the final code.
No verifier child produced a trapped finding; verification was parent-run and its results were visible before closure.
No required child failure, abort, or cancellation occurred, so there was no unfinished child scope requiring takeover.
Completed child findings were not ignored; the parent explicitly used the converged reports to build the parser and verification suite.
The parent waited for a completed AgentSwarm result and then acted; no timeout or near-deadline wait without inspection occurred.
No child wrote competing implementation paths; parent alone created the final Cargo and source files after probes completed.
There is no evidence of two live agents editing the same source or configuration file.
No agent replaced non-entry source produced or actively owned by another agent; parent-owned source writes were sequential.
The required test7.rs and executable were written by the parent, with no concurrent deliverable owner or replacement conflict.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion invalidated another actor's final-tree work or provenance.
Although the workspace was shared, children only probed and reported; no unstable shared-write provenance problem materialized.
No generated artifact, cache, fixture, or temporary output from one concurrent actor was consumed as stable input by another actor.
